finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical: 1082 hits in 94 files.** Four zones must not be renamed.

| Zone | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/` | 37 | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 12 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract. Needs a new dated version. |
| `lib/serialize.js` | 1 | `WIRE` right side is the public key. |

Also frozen: the SQL column name inside repo query strings, roughly 125 hits across 25 `repo/*.js` files. The DB column stays `account_id` until a migration renames it.

Safe to rename now: about 900 JS identifiers in `services/` plus the field in `[lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8)`.

Ask them to split it into two PRs: variables first, column later.
